translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Iwe a pwan aepesa pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe eyor aaemweoi aeremas igeei resoapw mae, toori oatona repwe weri itton minna Mweoiun Deus epwe itto noan mamaaw.”
Nniuwen Noan Wunuunun Jesus
Mwirin wonowu raaen nge Jesus a paeniir tae Peter, James me John wooan eew rhug taegias, nge a iir noa rhag ee. Igiwe re rhiuwen oawruru Jesus, nge a nniuwen noa wunuunun,
mengaagiun a moanuponup reen aan pwerheraeg noa, pwerheraeg saengi mwo nge wupwuwaen erhai mengaag me noan faeinaengiy.
Iwe nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe eoniurhai ra weri Elijah me Moses aar kkepas ngaeni Jesus.
Iwe Peter a aengaeni Jesus pwe, “Sinsei, a igin gacch pwe sino igeei. Aeipwe aiuwtae enuuw iimw tampwoning, eew imwoamw, eew imwaen Moses, me eew imwaen Elijah.”
Iiy me rhooa kkewe rhoaniuwan ra igin mesag, iwe Peter esa giuneei no meeta epwe rhiuwen aepesa.
Iwe eew toapw a itto pwaniiur noa, nge ra rongorong eew mangiungiu e itto me noan toapw we, “Ieei Naeyi mwaaen aerhaengerhaeng, oaw aiussaening ngaeni!”
Ra mwetekkaein wegitaeg fetaen nge esooar ne reweri, pwe aaen Jesus rhag minne eno reer.
Igiwe ra ittiw me wooan rhug we, Jesus a igin ammwir ngaeniir pwe, “Oawsoapw aengaeni mwo nge erhai meeta oawwa weri, toori aaen mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas epwe menaw sefaaen me reen maenoa.”
Ra tapweei meeta we e Jesus e ammwir ngaeniir, nge a rhaepetae aar kkepas aeiyeg fengaen wooar, “Meeta faan minne menaw sefaaen saengi mae noa?”
Iwe ra aeiineow Jesus, “Meeta sinsein anniug ra aepesa, pwe Elijah epwe gommwoto reen?”

A paniuwaeniir pwe, “Epwe fasiun gommwoto Elijah pwe epwe itto oamoannatae oanongaen aegiaeg. Nge meeta rhag a foatofoat noan Pwapwior we e Santus pwe Naiun Aeremas epwe toonong noan waeiraes faeregit me aar oasoarhoawuna?
Ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe Elijah a fasiun itto, nge aeremas ra feeori ngaeni meeta aar mwerhaen, taeppen rhag meeta we Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa.”
Jesus e Aecchipwa Erhai Aetemwaaen Eyor Aniu Aenneew Wooan
Igiwe ra rhu fengaen me rhooan kkayeo kkewe aaemweoi, ra giuneei pwuwaen aeremas kkewe re pwaeniaeniir me aaemweoi sinsein anniug re aengiingi ngaeniir.
Igiwe aeremas kkewe ra giuneei Jesus, ra riutae, ra fattapw noa reen ra noa aewenimmwa.
Jesus a aeiineeor rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe, “Meeta mwu oaw aengiingi fengaen wooan?”
Erhai mwaaen me neeiir rhooa towunap we a paniuwaeni pwe, “Sinsei, iya pwigito aete naeyi reemw, pwe eyor aniu aenneew wooan nge ese mmwenen kkepas.

Oate aniu aenneew een epwe wartae wooan, a oatoratiw ne ppweon, nge a pwuropwur wow me noan ewan, e iin noa ngiin iwe me e cchemaw noa oanongaen. Iya aeiyegiir rhooan kkayeo kka noawumw pwe repwe oatowowuw aniu een me wooan, nge ese mmwen ngaeniir.”
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Ifa mwo aaemi se niugiuniug faaen oateei! Epwe ifa ssiunaein aaei ipwe no reemi? Epwe ifa wusun aaei noaneenaei reemi? Oaw pwigito aetena reei!”
Ra pwigito aet we reen Jesus. Igiwe rhag aniu aenneew we eweri Jesus, a ngong noa aetewe, iwe a ppiungiutiw ne ppweon a ittiw soagopenipen fetaen nge a pwuropwur wow me noan ewan.
Jesus a aeiineow mwaaen we semaen aetewe pwe, “A ifa pwongiaen aan ieei wusun?” Mwaaen we semaen aetewe a paniuwaeni pwe, “Saengi rhag ne wonigaeten.
A faei towunap aaen aniu aenneew een menaen epwe niiy noa reen aan aerheei nong noan aengaet me ne rhaan. Faayeogemaem me tipaengi gimaem, aere emmwen ngaeniug!”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ooa, aere een emmwen ngaeniug! Oanongaen aegiaeg nge emmwen ngaeni erhai ne eyor aan niugiuniug.”
Mwaaen we semaen aetewe a aekkepwas temoag tae pwe, “Ngaang i niugiuniug nge egius rhag, tipaengiaei epwe temoag noa aaei niugiuniug.”

Jesus a giuneei pwe aeremas towunap kkewe ra arapeto reer, iwe a asiuw aniu aenneew we. “Aniun oawparh me saeningapiung, i aengaeniug pwe wopwe toowow me reen aetena, nge wosoapw rhiuwen sefaaeniti no!”
Aniu aenneew we a aekkepwas tae, nge a ngong noa aetewe nge a tiw noa me wooan. A weei rhag erhai manimae kkewe, nge rhooa towunap kkewe ra aepesa pwe, “A maenoa!”
Nge Jesus a ammwarhiu paiun aet we nge a tipaengitae, iwe aetewe a iutae.
Mwirin aaen Jesus toonong nee iimw, rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra aeiineow igiwe a iir noa rhag pwe, “Meeta aemaem aeise mmwenen oatowowuw aniu aenneew we reen?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Aeggaen maeipin rhag minne emmwen epwe oatowowuur aniu kaan, esooar pwan eew me niugiunoan.”
Jesus a Pwan Aepesa Wunuunun Aan Maenoa
Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra noa saengi pwiuneoi we nge ra mwetenoa wooan Galilee. Jesus ese mwerhaen pwe aeremas repwe giuneei iga eno e,
pwe iga e fenaiiur rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe: “Mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas epwene yonong nee paiiur aeremas kena repwe niiy noa. Nge mwirin enuuw raaen epwe menaw sefaaen.”
Nge rese metefaaegini faaen miniwe e aeni fenai, nge re mesag aar repwe aeiineow.
Iyo e oarosaen Taegias?
Igiwe ra itto Capernaum, nge ra toonong nee iimw, Jesus a aeiineeor rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe, “Meeta we oaw aengiingi fengaen wooan me wooan ennap?”
Nge iir resa paniuwaeni no, pwe iga re aengiingi me wooan ennap aere iyo e oarosaen taegias me neeiir.

Iwe Jesus a mooat tiw, a faingiir rhooan kkayeo kkewe seig me riiurhai nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Aere erhai ne e mwerhaen pwe epwe gommw, nge iiy epwe oarosaen noa aeremas nge epwe pwan engaang ngaeniir oanongeer aeremas.”
A pwigi erhai wonigaet a aiuwtae me weni mmweer. A ammwarhiu aetewe nge a aengaeniir pwe,
“Iyo e aetiwa erhai wonigaet kaan faaen itaei e aetiwaeyaei, nge iyo e aetiwaeyaei ese aetiwaeyaei rhag pwe epwan aetiwa iyo we efangeto ngaang.”
Iyo Ese Appaniuwaenigirh Iiy Rhoaniuwarh
John a aengaeni pwe, “Sinsei, aeiweri erhai mwaaen a oatowowuw aniu aenneew faaen itoamw, nge aeiya aengaeni pwe epwe iug noa, pwe iiy saapw rhoaniuwarh.”
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawsoapw aiugiu noa mwaaen na, pwe esooar erhai ne epwe feeori eew manaman faaen itaei, nge epwe sor sefaaen nge aepesa eew min aenneew faaen itaei.
Pwe iyo ese appaniuwaenigirh nge iiy rhoaniuwarh.
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe iyo e aiuniu gaemi rhaan pwe iga aaemi naeyi, iiy epwe yo ngaeni minna paniuwaenin.”
Sessoaton Monofit
“Aere erhai efeeori pwe erhai maan mwittig kaan epwe maniuwegini noa aan niugiuniug reei, nge efaer gacch pwe epwe geeogeeotae efai faai faaen iiuwan nge a noa aekkaerh noa nee metaw.

Aere poawumw efeeori pwe epwe ppiung noa oamw niugiuniug, gopiy noa! Efaer gacch oamw wopwe pai efoarh nge wotonong noan menaw na esooar iyaenin, mmwaen oamw wopwe pai riiufoarh nge wonoa noan nifierno, noan aengaet we ese mmwenen gunnoa.
[Igiwe mwussoa kkewe egaen worheer nge rese mmwenen maenoa, nge aengaet na egaen figiir ese mmwenen gunnoa.]

Aere pirhemw efeeori pwe epwe ppiung noa oamw niugiuniug, gopiy noa. Efaer gacch oamw wopwe pirhe efoarh nge wotonong noan menaw na esooar iyaenin, mmwaen oamw wopwe pirhe riiufoarh nge ra aerheog nong noan nifierno.
[Igiwe mwussoa kkewe egaen worheer nge rese mmwenen maenoa, nge aengaet na egaen figiir ese mmwenen gunnoa.]

Aere mesoamw efeeori pwe epwe ppiung noa oamw niugiuniug, oannusuwow! Efaer gacch oamw wopwe toonong noan minna Mweoiun Deus reen oamw maseyefai, mmwaen oamw wopwe maseriufai nge ra aerheog nong noan nifierno.
Igiwe mwussoa kkewe egaen worheer nge rese mmwenen maenoa, nge aengaet na egaen figiir ese mmwenen gunnoa.
“Aeremas towunap repwene nimegacch noa reen aengaet, taeppen eew oasoar e nimegacch noa reen aesiig.
“Aesiig egacch; nge igine epwe rhiuw noa saaetiin, nge epwe mmwen sipwe aesaaeti sefaaeniy? “Oayora aesigaen aerhaengerhaeng nee finaemi, nge oawno rhag noan oapoas ngaeni erhai me erhai aaemi.”

footnotes.text: Petenan eei nge e soano noan aekkaew petenan kka e foatofoat noan kkepesaen Greek.
